title: Induction rule choices
description: The choices a background or class asks for through a ChoiceSet rule element, as the induction terminal asks them on its own pages (core/induction-rule-choices.mjs; design/induction-terminal.md Page 3 and Page 4). Written into the catalogues by tools/character-builder/extract-rule-choices.mjs from the real compendium packs, never by hand: `--check` fails when a catalogue is behind the packs.

ruleChoices.description: One entry per question the item asks, in the order its rules ask them. Absent on an item that asks none. A ChoiceSet whose answer only feeds a GrantItem rule (a background's skill feat) is not here: the terminal drops the GrantItem, so it drops that question with it.

flag.description: The ChoiceSet's own flag (sf2e's `flags.<system>.rulesSelections.<flag>`); also the key of the player's answer in the terminal's state.

kind.description: `skill` when every option is one of the game's skills (the page says "trained in one of these"); `other` for any other list.

key.description: What the terminal keeps as the answer, unique within the question. For a skill, its slug.

label.description: English display name; the terminal localizes a skill's own name.
